Organization Chart

An organizational chart with hierarchical levels, connecting lines, collapsible branches, and employee cards with avatars.

Organization Chart

A multi-level org chart with CSS flexbox layout, connecting lines between levels, and collapsible branches.

HTML
<div class="org-chart">
  <div class="org-node org-root">
    <div class="org-card" style="text-align:center;">
      <div class="org-avatar">JD</div>
      <div class="org-name">Jane Doe</div>
      <div class="org-title">CEO</div>
    </div>
    <div class="org-children">
      <div class="org-connector"></div>
      <div class="org-node">...</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

Features

  • Hierarchical Layout — CEO at top, VPs in second row, Directors/Managers below, ICs at bottom.
  • Employee Cards — Circle avatar, name, and title in each card.
  • Connecting Lines — Visual lines connecting parent to children at each level.
  • Collapse/Expand — Click toggle button to collapse or expand branches.
  • Color-Coded Avatars — Each level uses a different avatar background color.
  • Responsive — Horizontal scroll for wide org charts.
